this_week_summary.text: Markets were uneven through July 31. Equities and foreign exchange were Stable; rates and government bonds, along with commodities, were Fragile; and crypto was Stressed. Commodities posted the strongest short-term gain among the included asset families at 1.1%, while crypto had the weakest short-term change at -4.1% and the deepest current full-history drawdown among the included public proxies. The aggregate included cross-asset state was Fragile.

state_changes.text: Commodities had the strongest short-term gain among the included asset families, rising 1.1% over the trailing five eligible observations.
Crypto had the weakest short-term change, falling 4.1% over the same comparison period and remaining Stressed.
Rates and government bonds remained Fragile, while equities and foreign exchange were Stable.
The aggregate included cross-asset state remained Fragile through July 31.

largest_positive_metric_shifts.text: Commodities had the strongest short-term gain among the included asset families, rising 1.1% over the trailing five eligible observations.

largest_negative_metric_shifts.text: Crypto had the weakest short-term change, falling 4.1% over the same comparison period and remaining Stressed.

items: Stability remained concentrated in equities and foreign exchange rather than spreading across the included asset families.
Crypto remained the clearest source of stress, combining the weakest short-term return with the deepest current full-history drawdown among the included public proxies.
Commodities improved over the short comparison period, but the broader trend remained Fragile.

regime_read.text: The Fragile reading reflects an uneven market configuration rather than uniform deterioration: two families remained Stable, but weakness across rates, commodities, and crypto prevented a broader constructive state.
